decision: NX-032 A2 (docs/implementation/NX-032-stage-publish-design.md §2.2, owner-approved 2026-10-15): the frozen capability snapshots the stage publication binds Actions and Functions to. schema_hash is computed by nexloop_eios.catalog_manifests from the contract (never written by hand); a snapshot is immutable once published, so a contract change is a new capability_version and a new Action version. Governed capabilities must be registered in control.nexloop_governed_capabilities by a migration, and their contract names the registered operation. Version 1 holds the capabilities of business-actions.v1.json, the six workbench goal capabilities, and the system Actions and Functions of system-actions.v1.json (T1 list). Function snapshots are side-effect free (conversation_effect_receipts and conversation_scope_denials require it); read-only Actions say why they are side-effecting. NX-056 A1 (owner 2026-10-22 Q1 option A, ADR-039 draft): nexloop.approvals.decide (approve or reject one waiting unified Approval with a reason; an active member whose current workbench role is one of the policy's approver roles, never the requester by subject, once) and nexloop.approvals.cancel (the requester withdraws their own waiting Approval with a reason). Nothing is executed by either: a request runs only when its requester resubmits it and consumes the approved Approval (A2). v3 (NX-056 A5): consumer.erase_on_request, the governed operation erase_consumer_on_request. v4 (NX-056 A7): approvals.solo_mode.set, the governed operation set_approval_solo_mode. v5 (extraction dead letters): claim_extraction.dead_letter_resolve, the governed operation resolve_extraction_dead_letter.
